summary: All 25 simpNF lint errors analyzed across 6 files. Root cause: derived connectives are abbrevs that unfold transparently, so their simp lemmas have LHS that already simplifies via primitive constructor simp lemmas. Fix: remove @[simp] from all 25 declarations. No downstream code depends on global simp set membership. Risk: LOW.
